resolved_findings.finding: Inter-frame silence was subject to the frame deadline, disconnecting idle sessions and long queries.
resolved_findings.resolution: read_frame waits without a deadline for the first byte and bounds the remaining header/body; independently verified idle and partial-frame behavior.

resolved_findings.finding: Pinned pg_dump/restore emits restrict_nonsystem_relation_kind set_config SQL and vector WITH SCHEMA public, both originally rejected.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact utility templates now permit the pinned forms and reject altered encoding/string-setting keys, other schemas and compound SQL. Confirmed local PostgreSQL source call sites and independent gate probes.

resolved_findings.finding: Per-read startup timeouts could repeatedly renew the advertised 15-second handshake deadline.
resolved_findings.resolution: A session timer now spans startup, backend connect, authentication and first ReadyForQuery; fragmented startup, delayed backend readiness and post-ready survival tests pass.

resolved_findings.finding: Explicit stop left an owned proxy running when PostgreSQL was already down.
resolved_findings.resolution: bootstrap stop now always stops the recorded owned proxy before conditionally stopping the database; source inspection only.

resolved_findings.finding: Existing table inline constraints and column drift were not validated by CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and named added-constraint checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: apply_migrations now compares the complete captured table/column/constraint/index catalog with a checked-in expected manifest inside the migration transaction. Added real-database negatives cover a dropped variant FK, dropped record CHECK and altered column; execution of those real tests remains pending in this review.

resolved_findings.finding: On-disk fingerprint equality could certify tests against a stale already-running proxy.
resolved_findings.resolution: Proxy records startup-loaded source/lock hashes; runtime verifier compares them with current files and parser binary/profile and requires stable process identity across the test run. A final restart and real run remain required.

Ran independent shortened-deadline StreamReader probes: idle first-byte wait preserved; stalled partial header and partial body time out.

Ran all current RealParserGateTests, FrameDeadlineTests and HandshakeDeadlineTests: 11 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors. Guard tests include nested opaque rejection, lexical-mode denial, warm-cache binary tamper and exact dump/restore utility templates.
observations: No remaining concrete accepted-SQL bypass was found in the reviewed code. Q/P strings pass the gate before forwarding; bound values and COPY payloads remain data. Fast-path functions and untracked SQL PREPARE/EXECUTE are denied.

Prepared-object state is deliberately conservative and may reject valid PostgreSQL lifetimes. Every retained portal captures previously admitted statement payload; this review does not assert exact backend object correspondence.

Endpoint normalization rejects supported environment, service, hostaddr and multihost bypasses. Bootstrap disables backend TCP; direct host-administrator access to the private backend remains outside the stated local trust model.

Parser subprocess limits, strict response checks, production-based denial, bounded cache and identity checks are implemented. Ordinary trusted function effect analysis remains excluded by specification.
